newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gorbachev says Deng father of Chinese reform.
newsitem.headline: Gorbachev says Deng father of Chinese reform.

text.p: Former Soviet president Mikhail Gorbachev on Wednesday hailed the late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping as a great man who opened a new era of development in his country, Ekho Moskvy news agency said.

"The fate of this man was very close to me," said Gorbachev who, like Deng, rose through the ranks of the Communist Party and spearheaded changes in the Soviet Union as revolutionary as those led by Deng in neighbouring China.

"The drama he lived through was the drama of a great man who underwent the cult of Mao and everything linked with that and the Cultural Revolution and yet kept his ideas intact and managed to implement them when life gave him the chance."
"Deng Xiaoping was the father of Chinese reform, a man who was not stuck on dogma and represented the reformist forces in the Chinese Communist Party," the agency quoted Gorbachev as saying.
"He assumed responsibility and obtained the backing of both the party and society in the end. He opened a new era in the development of that vast country."

Gorbachev, whose attempts at a political comeback since he was forced out of office by the Soviet Union's collapse in 1991 have been greeted with widespread derision, could have been mouthing the obituary he would like to receive himself.

His own attempts to reform the ruling Communist Party led to its downfall and the beginnings of democracy while his economic reforms were less far-reaching than those in China, where political controls remain tight.

"I wish to give that man his due, that man who lived a great, difficult, dramatic and tragic life and left a deep imprint on Chinese history and the history of the development of the whole world," said Gorbachev of Deng .
"He was a man who could look at life and processes realistically, without becoming stuck on ... dead dogma, and who was able to look a developing and changing China and the world in the eyes."
